cases.name: Entry waits for just the first scene and does not eagerly allocate all scene/frame images
All twenty exclusive beats keep exact boundaries and the title holds at 84000ms
Fades, bounded zoom, text/art exclusion and per-beat announcements are retained
Pause/Resume retain elapsed time and zoom
Visibility and pagehide require explicit Resume
Slow art freezes the cinematic at its image boundary, without consuming its fade
Pause or background during buffering prevents auto-resume when decoding completes
Reading holds every card/image, supports Back and waits for Finish
Native keyboard controls, Space, Escape and reading arrows are preserved
Paused rotation retains visible old art, beat, time and zoom during replacement
Playing rotation uses actual stage aspect and never resets progress
Rapid rotations and reading navigation abort obsolete sources; stale loads never win
Loading failure exposes retry and does not strand the clock or navigation
Repeated Skip/Replay clears owned art, keeps mode, one RAF and stable listeners
Reduced motion removes fades/zoom, including changes during playback
Fresh callback time handles stale RAF timestamps; start hook fires once per activation
Portrait entry decodes only its first scene; timed and reading hints agree with v8
Every new image uses its allocated fades and clears art before the following card/title
All six new image loads hold their full duration and fade despite long wall-clock waits
Playing and paused rotations in each new image preserve clock, zoom and old art while decoding
Reading progress spans twenty beats; final image holds without loading or looping and Back remains usable
A pending new-scene decode cannot resurrect art after Skip; stale callback timestamps cannot delay new cards
Pause immediately before and during every new image preserves beat time through the full ending
Background during new-scene orientation decoding requires Resume after replacement completes
Every new timed image recovers from decode failure, including failure and retry while background-paused
Rapid navigation through the complete reading sequence and resizing clears every discarded source
Default profile supplies protagonist, companions and one camera operator to each start activation
POV approach uses authored far/mid/near frames at exact internal boundaries, without repeated announcements or zoom
Both missing internal approach frames hold at their own boundaries and background completion never auto-resumes
A missing drop frame holds before the camera moves, then one upward projection ends on the lower view
Rotation during an internal fade keeps old art and local progress while replacement and next frame decode
Paused rotation during the drop retains camera/fade progress without restarting the event
Reduced motion selects stable near/drop frames and never requests unused far/mid views
Reading POV sequences finish once, hold for thirty seconds and reentry starts a fresh local instance
Incomplete alternate fixed profiles and unfinished selectable builds fail clearly rather than use magnet art
An in-flight internal-frame decode cannot overwrite Skip/Replay or resurrect its old instance
Drop displacement uses contained image height in short landscape and preserves normalized progress on resize
Changing reduced motion during an interrupted internal fade cancels the obsolete frame requirement
An internal-frame decode error exposes retry and its obsolete failed source cannot reattach
All three role profiles resolve their own hands, cast, phone and frame keys without activating unavailable artwork
Role validation rejects duplicated phones, wrong prop hands, wrong companion casts and missing profile alts
Flipping alternate enablement flags cannot bypass the missing-art guard
Active profile supplies image alt text and announcements rather than hardcoded scout descriptions
Every internal frame error holds its local boundary, retries without restarting and respects background Resume
Reading drop plays once, holds beyond thirty seconds and Back/reentry gets a fresh frame instance
Portrait, short-landscape and wide-desktop stage bounds retain single-clock camera progress
Every tested path owns at most two sourced images and uses no audio engine
